note: build-from-deck 0.6.0: three stages. Only S1 (Deck Reader: INTAKE, PANELS, DRAFT, FINALIZE) run on the runner; S2 Design is Claude on the live canvas through the connector and S3 3D is the editor's own export (pipeline.export3d). A runner stage "uses" <alias>:<STEP> of a pinned skill; its commands come from the skill's skill.json and run in the skill's folder. "stage" groups jobs into S1…S5: a job of Sn runs only after the USER approved S(n-1) in the step bar (run.json), and the runner writes {DIR}stages/<Sn>/progress.json for the app's live progress. Agent steps (curate, trace, resolve, improve) are Claude's: it writes their files with library.write and reports to {DIR}stages/<Sn>/agent-progress.json. R2 data folders under steps/ keep their 0.3 names (S1_INTAKE, S2_BRIEF, S3_GEOMETRY, S4_RESOLVE, S5_COMPOSE, S7_3D). Placeholders: {CODE} {WORK} {PROJ} {STEPS} {OUT} {DIR} {SKILL} {ARG:x} {BASENAME:x} {REPO}. 0.5: the deck may be a moodboard IMAGE (S1_PANELS cuts Claude's panels.json into slides); S3 binds Python (object/2) objects and textured materials made by the Object Maker / Material Maker skills from the item crops; S4 embeds and bakes the Python objects.

S1_INTAKE.next: PPTX/PDF: the USER answers the questions in the Brief tab, then queue S1_DRAFT. IMAGE (deck.json needs_panels): AGENT marks the panels (Deck Reader read-an-image-deck.md) → write {STEPS}S1_INTAKE/panels.json (one board, or "boards" when the image holds several plans / moodboards), then queue S1_PANELS.
S1_INTAKE.title: Read the deck (PPTX, PDF or a moodboard IMAGE) and list the questions

S1_PANELS.title: Cut the image's panels into slides, file each crop under inputs/images/, list the questions
S1_PANELS.next: Every crop is now its own input: Projects/{CODE}/inputs/images/<source>/<board>/<category>/<id>.png (+ index.json). The USER answers the questions in the Brief tab (answers/main) — with several boards the first question picks the board. Then queue S1_DRAFT with { project, room } from their answer.

args.board: the board (floorplan) the user chose: questions.json room_ids[<answer>].board — only it is cropped

S1_DRAFT.next: AGENT: read the draft + the slide images, write roombrief.curated.json (typed params per item, zones, cameras, checks) to {STEPS}S2_BRIEF/roombrief.curated.json, then queue S2_FINALIZE. The user approves the Brief tab.
S1_DRAFT.title: Draft the room brief from the deck

S1_FINALIZE.next: The USER approves S1 Brief in the step bar. Then S2: trace the plan with the Floorplan Tracer (its own approvals), then queue S2_FROM_TRACER.
S1_FINALIZE.title: Check the curated brief covers every room slide
